versions.changelog:
- Updated documentation for clarity, added prerequisite and installation instructions, and clarified usage examples.
- Improved metadata: changed skill name to "sonos-music-search-skill," updated emoji, and removed deprecated "install" metadata.
- Added safety and usability notes, including discovery timeout protection and safe search defaults.
- Introduced support for CLI scripts and formatting commands in the documentation.
- Added package-lock.json for consistent dependency management.

Initial release of Sonos Music Search skill.

- Search for Spotify tracks via Brave Search API and play them on Sonos speakers.
- Instantly auto-plays found tracks on any Sonos speaker in your network.
- View information about the currently playing track.
- Requires BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable, Sonos speaker, and Node.js 18+.
